name: Atulya portable runtime
description: Everything Atulya needs to run offline is downloaded into ./runtime so the whole project folder is portable across machines. Nothing is installed system-wide, nothing runs hidden, and this file lists exactly what the installer fetches.
consent: By running install/setup.ps1 (Windows) or install/setup.sh you agree to download the components below into ./runtime on a machine you own or are authorized to manage.

components.name: Brain — Qwen3-0.6B (Q4_K_M GGUF)
components.purpose: Local language model that thinks, chats and calls tools. Runs on CPU.

components.name: Mouth — Piper TTS engine
components.purpose: Offline text-to-speech. No API key, no account.

components.name: Ears — faster-whisper (base, int8)
components.purpose: Offline speech-to-text. Model files are fetched on first use into runtime/models/whisper.
